swap_risks: CAUTION PACKAGE HEIGHT/PROFILE: AP63300WU-7 (TSOT-23-6) vs TPS54202DDCR (SOT-23-6) share the same JEDEC land pattern pitch, but thin-profile TSOT (~1.0 mm) vs standard SOT (~1.45 mm) differs in body height; verify enclosure Z-clearance, SMT nozzle height, and solder fillet spec.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (FB vs GND), Pin 2 (EN vs SW), Pin 4 (GND vs FB), Pin 5 (SW vs EN). Soldering TPS54202DDCR onto a AP63300WU-7 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
HIGH MINIMUM OUTPUT VOLTAGE FLOOR: AP63300WU-7 cannot regulate below 0.8 V (p.5) vs TPS54202DDCR down to 0.596 V (p.5); verify your target rail sits above the higher Vout,min floor.
HIGH VREF MISMATCH: Feedback reference differs (AP63300WU-7: 0.8 V p.6 vs TPS54202DDCR: 0.596 V p.5); dropping in without recalculating R1/R2 will output the wrong voltage rail.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (AP63300WU-7: 6.8 µH p.2 vs TPS54202DDCR: 15 µH p.17); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: AP63300WU-7 specifies 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs TPS54202DDCR 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Verify continuous load current and peak inductor saturation margin (Isat >= Iout + ΔIL/2).
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 33% higher on TPS54202DDCR (AP63300WU-7: 89 °C/W p.5 vs TPS54202DDCR: 118.6 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: TPS54202DDCR requires Vin,min >= 4.5 V (p.4) vs 3.8 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP63300WU-7: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to 85°C TA, TJ max 125°C) vs TPS54202DDCR: -40..125 °C Industrial / Extended (-40°C to 125°C TJ)); AP63300WU-7 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP63300WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and TPS54202DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (FB vs GND), Pin 2 (EN vs SW), Pin 4 (GND vs FB), Pin 5 (SW vs EN). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (FB vs GND), Pin 2 (EN vs SW), Pin 4 (GND vs FB), Pin 5 (SW vs EN). Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency 500 kHz (p.6) vs 500 kHz (p.5) (1x ratio), typical inductor 6.8 µH (p.2) vs 15 µH (p.17), feedback Vref 0.8 V (p.6) vs 0.596 V (p.5), and package θJA 89 vs 118.6 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP63300WU-7 "CRITICAL PINOUT TRAP: Completely Incompatible With TI TPS54302/TPS54202/TPS563201/TPS562201 & AP62200!" (p.1) and TPS54202DDCR "CRITICAL: EN Pin Abs Max Is ONLY 7.0 V (Rec 5.5 V) — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V / 24 V VIN" (p.4). BOM decision: Choose AP63300WU-7 when higher load current capacity (3000 mA) is required or light-load battery standby needs 22 µA Iq; choose TPS54202DDCR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOT-23-6 (DDC) qualification and -40..125 °C grade. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
